description: Shrink sidebar model/harness icons from 14pt to 12pt using dedicated 12pt atlas slots in zeron.coax while preserving shared 14pt slots for other UI (from real desktop sidebar chat).

steps.send: Shrink the OpenAgents Desktop sidebar chat-card model/harness icons from 14pt to 12pt: 1) In `components/skin/zeron.coax`, add dedicated 12pt atlas slots (`ICON_CLAUDE_12`, `ICON_OPENAI_12`, `ICON_PSIONIC_12`, `ICON_ANTIGRAVITY_12`, `ICON_BOT_12`) while keeping the shared `ICON_CLAUDE_14` and `ICON_OPENAI_14` slots untouched for other UI. 2) In `components/app/nav.coax`, update `APP_SIDE_CARD_HARNESS_ICON` to `12.0f32` and map `app_side_card_harness_icon` to the new 12pt slots. 3) Update `components/app/nav-checks.coax` and `apps/openagents-desktop/page/checks/chats-checks.coax` assertions to verify the 12pt slots and sizes. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only chats && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/app-v1.coax --library`.

graders.run: grep -q 'APP_SIDE_CARD_HARNESS_ICON :: 12.0f32' components/app/nav.coax && grep -q 'ICON_ANTIGRAVITY_12' components/skin/zeron.coax && grep -q 'ICON_CLAUDE_14' components/skin/zeron.coax && grep -q 'ICON_OPENAI_14' components/skin/zeron.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only chats && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/app-v1.coax --library
